sanskrit: nāsya kiṃ cin na jānāmi bhojanādi cikīrṣitam nivedayati nityaṃ hi mama rājyaṃ dhṛtavrataḥ
english: I know nothing of his that he wishes done — food or anything else — without his informing me; firm in his vow, he always reports the kingdom to me.

sanskrit: tasya putro yathā pāṇḍus tathā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ guṇavāṃl lokavikhyātaḥ paurāṇāṃ ca susaṃmataḥ
english: His son is just as Pāṇḍu was — devoted to righteousness, virtuous, renowned throughout the world, and greatly honored by the citizens.

sanskrit: sa kathaṃ śakyam asmābhir apakraṣṭuṃ balād itaḥ pitṛpaitāmahād rājyāt sasahāyo viśeṣataḥ
english: How then can we forcibly wrest him from this kingdom inherited from his father and grandfather, especially when he has allies on his side?

sanskrit: bhṛtā hi pāṇḍunāmātyā balaṃ ca satataṃ bhṛtam bhṛtāḥ putrāś ca pautrāś ca teṣām api viśeṣataḥ
english: The ministers appointed by Pāṇḍu are maintained, the army is continually maintained, and even their sons and grandsons are especially well maintained.

sanskrit: te purā satkṛtās tāta pāṇḍunā pauravā janāḥ kathaṃ yudhiṣṭhirasyārthe na no hanyuḥ sabāndhavān
english: Those Paurava people who were honored in the past by Pāṇḍu, dear son — how would they not slay us along with our kinsmen for the sake of Yudhiṣṭhira?

sanskrit: duryodhana uvāca evam etan mayā tāta bhāvitaṃ doṣam ātmani dṛṣṭvā prakṛtayaḥ sarvā arthamānena yojitāḥ
english: Duryodhana said: All this has indeed been considered by me, father. Recognizing this weakness in myself, I have bound all the constituent elements of the state through gifts of wealth and honor.

sanskrit: dhruvam asmatsahāyās te bhaviṣyanti pradhānataḥ arthavargaḥ sahāmātyo matsaṃstho 'dya mahīpate
english: They shall certainly become our allies first and foremost; the leading men of wealth together with the ministers are now on my side, O lord of the earth.

sanskrit: sa bhavān pāṇḍavān āśu vivāsayitum arhati mṛdunaivābhyupāyena nagaraṃ vāraṇāvatam
english: Therefore you, sire, should quickly send the Pāṇḍavas away by gentle means to the city of Vāraṇāvata.

sanskrit: yadā pratiṣṭhitaṃ rājyaṃ mayi rājan bhaviṣyati tadā kuntī sahāpatyā punar eṣyati bhārata
english: When the kingdom is firmly established in me, O king, then Kuntī together with her sons shall return here, O Bhārata.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭra uvāca duryodhana mamāpy etad dhṛdi saṃparivartate abhiprāyasya pāpatvān naitat tu vivṛṇomy aham
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra said: Duryodhana, this very thought revolves in my heart too, but because of the wickedness of such an intention I do not disclose it.

sanskrit: na ca bhīṣmo na ca droṇo na kṣattā na ca gautamaḥ vivāsyamānān kaunteyān anumaṃsyanti karhi cit
english: Neither Bhīṣma, nor Droṇa, nor Kṣattā, nor Gautama will ever approve of the sons of Kuntī being sent into exile.

sanskrit: samā hi kauraveyāṇāṃ vayam ete ca putraka naite viṣamam iccheyur dharmayuktā manasvinaḥ
english: For we and they are equal among the Kauravas, my son; these righteous and high-minded men would never desire unfairness.

sanskrit: te vayaṃ kauraveyāṇām eteṣāṃ ca mahātmanām kathaṃ na vadhyatāṃ tāta gacchema jagatas tathā
english: How then would we not be condemned by the Kauravas and by these great-souled men, and likewise by the world, dear son?

sanskrit: duryodhana uvāca madhyasthaḥ satataṃ bhīṣmo droṇaputro mayi sthitaḥ yataḥ putras tato droṇo bhavitā nātra sāṃśayaḥ
english: Duryodhana said: Bhīṣma is always neutral; Droṇa's son stands on my side; wherever the son goes, so will Droṇa — there is no doubt in this.

sanskrit: kṛpaḥ śāradvataś caiva yata ete trayas tataḥ droṇaṃ ca bhāgineyaṃ ca na sa tyakṣyati karhi cit
english: Kṛpa, the son of Śaradvan — wherever these three go, he will follow, and he will never abandon Droṇa and his sister's son.

sanskrit: kṣattārthabaddhas tv asmākaṃ pracchannaṃ tu yataḥ pare na caikaḥ sa samartho 'smān pāṇḍavārthe prabādhitum
english: Kṣattā is indeed bound to us by self-interest, and where the others stand is hidden; he alone is not capable of opposing us for the sake of the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: sa viśrabdhaḥ pāṇḍuputrān saha mātrā vivāsaya vāraṇāvatam adyaiva nātra doṣo bhaviṣyati
english: Therefore, with confidence, send the sons of Pāṇḍu along with their mother into exile at Vāraṇāvata this very day — no fault will arise from this.

sanskrit: vinidrakaraṇaṃ ghoraṃ hṛdi śalyam ivārpitam śokapāvakam udbhūtaṃ karmaṇaitena nāśaya
english: This terrible thing that robs one of sleep, like a dart lodged in the heart — this blazing fire of grief — extinguish it by this course of action.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca tato duryodhano rājā sarvās tāḥ prakṛtīḥ śanaiḥ arthamānapradānābhyāṃ saṃjahāra sahānujaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: Then King Duryodhana, together with his younger brothers, gradually won over all those constituent elements of the state through gifts of wealth and honor.

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭraprayuktās tu ke cit kuśalamantriṇaḥ kathayāṃ cakrire ramyaṃ nagaraṃ vāraṇāvatam
english: Certain clever ministers deployed by Dhṛtarāṣṭra began to speak of the pleasant city of Vāraṇāvata.

sanskrit: ayaṃ samājaḥ sumahān ramaṇīyatamo bhuvi upasthitaḥ paśupater nagare vāraṇāvate
english: "A great festival is taking place, the most delightful on earth, in the city of Vāraṇāvata, the city of the Lord of Beasts."

sanskrit: sarvaratnasamākīrṇe puṃsāṃ deśe manorame ity evaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya vacanāc cakrire kathāḥ
english: "It is a region filled with all precious gems, a place that delights the hearts of men." Thus, on the instruction of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, they spread such talk.

sanskrit: kathyamāne tathā ramye nagare vāraṇāvate gamane pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ jajñe tatra matir nṛpa
english: As the pleasant city of Vāraṇāvata was thus being spoken of, O king, there arose in the minds of the sons of Pāṇḍu a desire to go there.

sanskrit: yadā tv amanyata nṛpo jātakautūhalā iti uvācainān atha tadā pāṇḍavān ambikāsutaḥ
english: When the king judged that their curiosity had been aroused, the son of Ambikā then addressed the Pāṇḍavas thus.

sanskrit: mameme puruṣā nityaṃ kathayanti punaḥ punaḥ ramaṇīyataraṃ loke nagaraṃ vāraṇāvatam
english: "These men of mine constantly speak again and again of the city of Vāraṇāvata as the most delightful in the world."

sanskrit: te tāta yadi manyadhvam utsavaṃ vāraṇāvate sagaṇāḥ sānuyātrāś ca viharadhvaṃ yathāmarāḥ
english: "If you think fit, dear sons, go with your retinues and attendants to enjoy the festival at Vāraṇāvata, like the gods at play."

sanskrit: brāhmaṇebhyaś ca ratnāni gāyanebhyaś ca sarvaśaḥ prayacchadhvaṃ yathākāmaṃ devā iva suvarcasaḥ
english: "Bestow gems on the Brahmins and on singers of all kinds as you please, like radiant gods."

sanskrit: kaṃ cit kālaṃ vihṛtyaivam anubhūya parāṃ mudam idaṃ vai hāstinapuraṃ sukhinaḥ punar eṣyatha
english: "Having sported there for some time and experienced the greatest joy, you shall return here to Hāstinapura, happy and well."

sanskrit: dhṛtarāṣṭrasya taṃ kāmam anubuddhvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ātmanaś cāsahāyatvaṃ tatheti pratyuvāca tam
english: Perceiving the intention of Dhṛtarāṣṭra and also his own helplessness, Yudhiṣṭhira replied to him with the words "So be it."

sanskrit: tato bhīṣmaṃ mahāprājñaṃ viduraṃ ca mahāmatim droṇaṃ ca bāhlikaṃ caiva somadattaṃ ca kauravam
english: Then Yudhiṣṭhira, quietly and with a heavy heart, spoke these words to the greatly wise Bhīṣma, the high-minded Vidura, Droṇa, Bāhlika, and the Kaurava Somadatta,

sanskrit: kṛpam ācāryaputraṃ ca gāndhārīṃ ca yaśasvinīm yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śanair dīnam uvācedaṃ vacas tadā
english: to Kṛpa, to the son of the preceptor, and to the glorious Gāndhārī — Yudhiṣṭhira softly and sorrowfully spoke these words to them at that time.

sanskrit: ramaṇīye janākīrṇe nagare vāraṇāvate sagaṇās tāta vatsyāmo dhṛtarāṣṭrasya śāsanāt
english: "We shall dwell in the pleasant and populous city of Vāraṇāvata with our retinues, dear sir, by the command of Dhṛtarāṣṭra."

sanskrit: prasannamanasaḥ sarve puṇyā vāco vimuñcata āśīrbhir vardhitān asmān na pāpaṃ prasahiṣyati
english: "With cheerful minds, all of you utter auspicious words; may evil not overpower us when we are strengthened by your blessings."

sanskrit: evam uktās tu te sarve pāṇḍuputreṇa kauravāḥ prasannavadanā bhūtvā te 'bhyavartanta pāṇḍavān
english: Thus addressed by the son of Pāṇḍu, all those Kauravas, with cheerful faces, turned toward the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: svasty astu vaḥ pathi sadā bhūtebhyaś caiva sarvaśaḥ mā ca vo 'stv aśubhaṃ kiṃ cit sarvataḥ pāṇḍunandanāḥ
english: "May you ever fare well upon the road, and may all beings everywhere bless you; may no ill whatsoever befall you from any quarter, O sons of Pāṇḍu."

sanskrit: tataḥ kṛtasvastyayanā rājyalābhāya pāṇḍavāḥ kṛtvā sarvāṇi kāryāṇi prayayur vāraṇāvatam
english: Then the Pāṇḍavas, having been blessed with good omens and with the aim of regaining the kingdom, completed all their duties and departed for Vāraṇāvata.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca evam ukteṣu rājñā tu pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu duryodhanaḥ paraṃ harṣam ājagāma durātmavān
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: When the great-souled Pāṇḍavas had been thus addressed by the king, the wicked Duryodhana was overcome with great joy.

sanskrit: sa purocanam ekāntam ānīya bharatarṣabha gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe pāṇau sacivaṃ vākyam abravīt
english: He took his minister Purocana aside in private, O bull of the Bharatas, and grasping his right hand, spoke these words to him.

sanskrit: mameyaṃ vasusaṃpūrṇā purocana vasuṃdharā yatheyaṃ mama tadvat te sa tāṃ rakṣitum arhasi
english: "This earth full of wealth is mine, Purocana; as it is mine, so it is yours — therefore you must guard it."

sanskrit: na hi me kaś cid anyo 'sti vaiśvāsikataras tvayā sahāyo yena saṃdhāya mantrayeyaṃ yathā tvayā
english: "For there is no other ally of mine more trustworthy than you, with whom I might deliberate and conspire as I can with you."

sanskrit: saṃrakṣa tāta mantraṃ ca sapatnāṃś ca mamoddhara nipuṇenābhyupāyena yad bravīmi tathā kuru
english: "Preserve secrecy, dear friend, and rid me of my enemies by a clever stratagem; do as I tell you."

sanskrit: pāṇḍavā dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa preṣitā vāraṇāvatam utsave vihariṣyanti dhṛtarāṣṭrasya śāsanāt
english: "The Pāṇḍavas have been sent by Dhṛtarāṣṭra to Vāraṇāvata; they will enjoy the festival there by Dhṛtarāṣṭra's command."

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ rāsabhayuktena syandanenāśugāminā vāraṇāvatam adyaiva yathā yāsi tathā kuru
english: "You yourself must go to Vāraṇāvata this very day by a swift chariot drawn by mules — see to it that you go."

sanskrit: tatra gatvā catuḥśālaṃ gṛhaṃ paramasaṃvṛtam āyudhāgāram āśritya kārayethā mahādhanam
english: "Having gone there, build near the armory a four-walled mansion, most well-enclosed, at great expense."

sanskrit: śaṇasarjarasādīni yāni dravyāṇi kāni cit āgneyāny uta santīha tāni sarvāṇi dāpaya
english: "Hemp, resin, and whatever other materials there are that are flammable — have all of them supplied there."

sanskrit: sarpiṣā ca satailena lākṣayā cāpy analpayā mṛttikāṃ miśrayitvā tvaṃ lepaṃ kuḍyeṣu dāpayeḥ
english: "Mix clay with clarified butter, oil, and a generous quantity of lac, and have this mixture plastered on the walls."

sanskrit: śaṇān vaṃśaṃ ghṛtaṃ dāru yantrāṇi vividhāni ca tasmin veśmani sarvāṇi nikṣipethāḥ samantataḥ
english: "Hemp, bamboo, ghee, timber, and various implements — deposit all of these inside that dwelling all around."

sanskrit: yathā ca tvāṃ na śaṅkeran parīkṣanto 'pi pāṇḍavāḥ āgneyam iti tat kāryam iti cānye ca mānavāḥ
english: "Do it in such a way that even if the Pāṇḍavas examine it, they will not suspect you, nor will other men think it a fire-trap."

sanskrit: veśmany evaṃ kṛte tatra kṛtvā tān paramārcitān vāsayeḥ pāṇḍaveyāṃś ca kuntīṃ ca sasuhṛjjanām
english: "When the house has been built in this way, honor the Pāṇḍavas greatly and lodge them there — the sons of Pāṇḍu and Kuntī together with her companions."

sanskrit: tatrāsanāni mukhyāni yānāni śayanāni ca vidhātavyāni pāṇḍūnāṃ yathā tuṣyeta me pitā
english: "The finest seats, carriages, and beds must be provided for the Pāṇḍavas, so that my father may be pleased."

sanskrit: yathā rameran viśrabdhā nagare vāraṇāvate tathā sarvaṃ vidhātavyaṃ yāvat kālasya paryayaḥ
english: "Everything must be arranged so that they live with full confidence and delight in the city of Vāraṇāvata until the turning of the right moment."

sanskrit: jñātvā tu tān suviśvastāñ śayānān akutobhayān agnis tatas tvayā deyo dvāratas tasya veśmanaḥ
english: "When you know that they are completely trusting, lying asleep without any fear, then you shall set fire to that dwelling from the door."

sanskrit: dagdhān evaṃ svake gehe dagdhā iti tato janāḥ jñātayo vā vadiṣyanti pāṇḍavārthāya karhi cit
english: "Burnt thus in their own house, people will say 'they were burned,' or their kinsmen may say so whenever they speak on behalf of the Pāṇḍavas."

sanskrit: tat tatheti pratijñāya kauravāya purocanaḥ prāyād rāsabhayuktena nagaraṃ vāraṇāvatam
english: Promising "So be it" to the Kaurava, Purocana departed for the city of Vāraṇāvata with a mule-drawn chariot.

sanskrit: sa gatvā tvarito rājan duryodhanamate sthitaḥ yathoktaṃ rājaputreṇa sarvaṃ cakre purocanaḥ
english: Having gone there swiftly, O king, standing firm in Duryodhana's resolve, Purocana did everything exactly as the prince had instructed.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca pāṇḍavās tu rathān yuktvā sadaśvair anilopamaiḥ ārohamāṇā bhīṣmasya pādau jagṛhur ārtavat
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: The Pāṇḍavas, having yoked their chariots with excellent horses peerless in speed, as they were about to mount, sorrowfully clasped Bhīṣma's feet.

sanskrit: rājñaś ca dhṛtarāṣṭrasya droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛddhānāṃ vidurasya kṛpasya ca
english: And those of King Dhṛtarāṣṭra and the great-souled Droṇa, and of all the other elders, and of Vidura and Kṛpa as well.

sanskrit: evaṃ sarvān kurūn vṛddhān abhivādya yatavratāḥ samāliṅgya samānāṃś ca bālaiś cāpy abhivāditāḥ
english: Thus the vow-observing Pāṇḍavas paid homage to all the elder Kurus, embraced those of equal station, and were saluted by the young.

sanskrit: sarvā mātṝs tathāpṛṣṭvā kṛtvā caiva pradakṣiṇam sarvāḥ prakṛtayaś caiva prayayur vāraṇāvatam
english: Having asked leave of all the mothers and circumambulated them, and having taken leave of all the constituent elements of the kingdom as well, they departed for Vāraṇāvata.

sanskrit: viduraś ca mahāprājñas tathānye kurupuṃgavāḥ paurāś ca puruṣavyāghrān anvayuḥ śokakarśitāḥ
english: The greatly wise Vidura and the other bulls of the Kuru race, and the citizens as well, followed those tigers among men, worn thin with grief.

sanskrit: tatra kec cid bruvanti sma brāhmaṇā nirbhayās tadā śocamānāḥ pāṇḍuputrān atīva bharatarṣabha
english: There, certain Brahmins spoke fearlessly at that time, grieving deeply for the sons of Pāṇḍu, O bull of the Bharatas.

sanskrit: viṣamaṃ paśyate rājā sarvathā tamasāvṛtaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ sudurbuddhir na ca dharmaṃ prapaśyati
english: "The king looks upon things with partiality; Dhṛtarāṣṭra, his mind utterly shrouded in darkness, is very evil-minded and does not perceive righteousness."

sanskrit: na hi pāpam apāpātmā rocayiṣyati pāṇḍavaḥ bhīmo vā balināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kaunteyo vā dhanaṃjayaḥ kuta eva mahāprājñau mādrīputrau kariṣyataḥ
english: "For the sinless Pāṇḍava would not sanction evil, nor would Bhīma the foremost among the strong, nor Dhanaṃjaya the son of Kuntī — how much less would the two greatly wise sons of Mādrī do so?"

sanskrit: tad rājyaṃ pitṛtaḥ prāptaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro na mṛṣyate adharmam akhilaṃ kiṃ nu bhīṣmo 'yam anumanyate vivāsyamānān asthāne kaunteyān bharatarṣabhān
english: "Dhṛtarāṣṭra cannot tolerate that kingdom obtained through their father; this is complete unrighteousness — why does this Bhīṣma approve of the sons of Kuntī, bulls of the Bharatas, being sent into banishment unjustly?"

sanskrit: piteva hi nṛpo 'smākam abhūc chāṃtanavaḥ purā vicitravīryo rājarṣiḥ pāṇḍuś ca kurunandanaḥ
english: "For the son of Śāṃtanu was like a father to us in former times, as was the royal sage Vicitravīrya, and Pāṇḍu the joy of the Kurus."

sanskrit: sa tasmin puruṣavyāghre diṣṭabhāvaṃ gate sati rājaputrān imān bālān dhṛtarāṣṭro na mṛṣyate
english: "Now that that tiger among men has met his destined end, Dhṛtarāṣṭra cannot bear these young princes."

sanskrit: vayam etad amṛṣyantaḥ sarva eva purottamāt gṛhān vihāya gacchāmo yatra yāti yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: "Unwilling to bear this, let us all abandon our homes in this greatest of cities and go wherever Yudhiṣṭhira goes."

sanskrit: tāṃs tathāvādinaḥ paurān duḥkhitān duḥkhakarśitaḥ uvāca paramaprīto dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: To those citizens speaking thus, distressed and worn with grief, the righteous king Yudhiṣṭhira spoke with the greatest affection, himself pained by their sorrow.

sanskrit: pitā mānyo guruḥ śreṣṭho yad āha pṛthivīpatiḥ aśaṅkamānais tat kāryam asmābhir iti no vratam
english: "What the lord of the earth has said, as our honored father and highest elder, that must be done by us without doubt — such is our vow."

sanskrit: bhavantaḥ suhṛdo 'smākam asmān kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam āśīrbhir abhinandyāsmān nivartadhvaṃ yathāgṛham
english: "You are our friends — circumambulate us, bless us with your benedictions, and then return each to your own home."

sanskrit: yadā tu kāryam asmākaṃ bhavadbhir upapatsyate tadā kariṣyatha mama priyāṇi ca hitāni ca
english: "When the occasion arises in which you can be of service to us, then you shall do what is dear and beneficial to me."

sanskrit: te tatheti pratijñāya kṛtvā caitān pradakṣiṇam āśīrbhir abhinandyaināñ jagmur nagaram eva hi
english: They promised "So be it," circumambulated the Pāṇḍavas, blessed them with benedictions, and returned to the city.

sanskrit: paureṣu tu nivṛtteṣu viduraḥ sarvadharmavit bodhayan pāṇḍavaśreṣṭham idaṃ vacanam abravīt prājñaḥ prājñaṃ pralāpajñaḥ samyag dharmārthadarśivān
english: When the citizens had turned back, Vidura — who knows all righteousness, a wise man speaking to a wise man, one who knows the language of the learned, one who truly perceives the ends of right and wealth — spoke these words to the foremost of the Pāṇḍavas to enlighten him.

sanskrit: vijñāyedaṃ tathā kuryād āpadaṃ nistared yathā alohaṃ niśitaṃ śastraṃ śarīraparikartanam yo vetti na tam āghnanti pratighātavidaṃ dviṣaḥ
english: "Understanding this, one should act in such a way as to cross over the danger. A weapon sharp without being of iron is what cuts through the body; he who knows this — and who knows the counter-blow — enemies cannot strike him down."

sanskrit: kakṣaghnaḥ śiśiraghnaś ca mahākakṣe bilaukasaḥ na dahed iti cātmānaṃ yo rakṣati sa jīvati
english: "The burner of dry grass and the burner of cold — the creature that dwells in holes in the great thicket — he who guards himself thinking 'it shall not burn me' is the one who lives."

sanskrit: nācakṣur vetti panthānaṃ nācakṣur vindate diśaḥ nādhṛtir bhūtim āpnoti budhyasvaivaṃ prabodhitaḥ
english: "One without eyes does not know the road; one without eyes does not find the directions; one without steadiness does not attain prosperity — understand this, you who have been awakened."

sanskrit: anāptair dattam ādatte naraḥ śastram alohajam śvāvic charaṇam āsādya pramucyeta hutāśanāt
english: "A man receives from those not close to him a weapon not made of iron; gaining the shelter of a porcupine's burrow, he can escape the consuming fire."

sanskrit: caran mārgān vijānāti nakṣatrair vindate diśaḥ ātmanā cātmanaḥ pañca pīḍayan nānupīḍyate
english: "By travelling one learns the paths; by the stars one finds the directions; by subduing one's five senses oneself, one is not afflicted."

sanskrit: anuśiṣṭvānugatvā ca kṛtvā cainān pradakṣiṇam pāṇḍavān abhyanujñāya viduraḥ prayayau gṛhān
english: Having given this counsel, having walked with them a little way, having circumambulated the Pāṇḍavas, and having bade them farewell, Vidura returned home.

sanskrit: nivṛtte vidure caiva bhīṣme paurajane tathā ajātaśatrum āmantrya kuntī vacanam abravīt
english: When Vidura and Bhīṣma and the citizens had turned back, Kuntī addressed Ajātaśatru and spoke these words.
